known_issues.issue: Battery not detected / BMS communication timeout in station slot
known_issues.probable_cause: Station-side connector wear; battery-side connector minor oxidation

known_issues.issue: Physical damage - casing scratch / handle crack
known_issues.probable_cause: Battery dropped by rider during swap

incident_history.symptoms: Battery not detected in slot 3 at station 01044; rider could not complete swap
incident_history.root_cause: Station slot 3 connector worn (station ticket INC-2026-05561). Battery connector had light oxidation
incident_history.resolution: Battery connector cleaned with contact cleaner and inspected (no pin damage). Battery inserted in slot 5 and detected successfully

incident_history.symptoms: Rider reported cracked handle after dropping battery
incident_history.root_cause: Mechanical impact from approximately 1 m drop
incident_history.resolution: Battery quarantined for 24 h observation (no temperature rise, no voltage drop, no swelling). Handle replaced, IP67 seal check passed, returned to service
